semantics: Running deadlines share one injected monotonic clock; children cannot extend the parent; expired remainder is zero. No new command starts with a fabricated minimum allowance.

Polling remains cooperative and preserves a late truthy observation. Generic workflow and terminal predicates retain their original error policy; only native wait_for retries explicitly safe Conflict.
Acceptance request writes and response framing share the original scenario deadline. Real pipe regressions use an independent real watchdog; fake clocks do not virtualize external I/O.
Command execution, check timeout and run cancellation remain distinct. Shutdown grace begins before TERM; one forced 5-second phase covers KILL, pipe drain, reap and group verification.

Supervisor cleanup is cooperative across terminal-host ports. Exact remaining grace may be zero; receipts expose elapsed cleanup, overrun and cleanup_deadline. ManagedWorker close, TERM and KILL remain intentionally separate phases.
Scale applies only to reviewed classified shared-support observations. Product guarantees, deliberate fault controls, command/run budgets and cleanup phases are not scaled.

The inventory retains historical e251 observations and a 22-group current review at 314e979, including intentional service-lifetime loops and independent provider/turn/storage limits. Separate runtime and operation-readiness candidates are not claimed as implemented here.
limits: No native vendor authentication or WSL/host-suspend qualification performed.
Hosted/native scenarios blocked by unavailable tmux or AF_UNIX sockets require an appropriate execution environment.
Arbitrary synchronous application, filesystem/proc and terminal-host calls are not preempted; requested timeouts are not strict total-return guarantees.
